description: Does one action of the financial-views step of alignment on one question, as the financial views page of the app does. Call get_alignment first: each question gives its actions. acknowledge: the customer read the different answer of the partner and accepts it. Show the answer of the partner first. answer: the customer changes the own answer, in the format of answer_format. Confirm the answer with the customer first. A changed answer asks the partner to review the financial views again. When each question is aligned, complete the step with complete_alignment_step.

value.description: The value of an input question.

name: review_financial_view

aligned.description: Each question of the financial views is aligned.

question.description: The question after the action, as get_alignment gives it. Not given when question_hidden is true.

question_hidden.description: True when the new answer hides the question from the financial views.

title: Review a financial view
